adaptation.objective: MSE(mean over actual learned XYZ whole-window average velocity), no auxiliary losses
adaptation.diagnostic_small_configuration: Only explicitly selected server scientific tests may use reduced widths/depths. Such tests do not admit the full profile or silently replace it.

outputs.semantic: real learned XYZ window-average velocity in m/s
outputs.xy_metric: slice the same XYZ prediction; no separate XY model or zero Z

adaptation.permissions: Existing six-axis IMU and train average-velocity labels only. Reference orientation is the admitted task-view rotation, not a separate model input. No runtime calibration/scaling statistics, pose, image, text, initial velocity, extra sensor or test-driven choice.
adaptation.loss_identity_policy: set_loss rejects all non-MSE losses and nonempty kwargs; adding source auxiliary or SSL terms requires a separately named pre-registered identity and budget.
retained: two fully independent gyro3/acc3 encoders (source S2/S1 modality separation adapted to genuine inertial modalities)
each branch Linear3->512/ReLU/Linear512->512, additive source sinusoidal temporal encoding
eight cloned post-norm TransformerEncoder layers per stream,8 heads,FF4096,ReLU,dropout0.1; modules separate, same initial clone values as released code
GRU512->512 zero hidden each call; learned query over GRU context yields softmax temporal weights; pool ORIGINAL Transformer tokens, not GRU outputs
ordered concatenate gyro then acc features and SINGLE Linear1024->128 reducer
new actual learned Linear128->XYZ velocity head
omitted: Barlow Twins redundancy-reduction SSL objective and its projector/BatchNorm modules
train-only random temporal sampling, paired views, global shuffled SSL curriculum, mix-based regularization
EO image/bands, geography and external calendar day-of-year inputs
upstream pretrained weights, v2, QAT, ONNX/raster/acquisition code
adaptation.position_adapter: Only inside-window index q=t_relative_seconds*200=0..199. Source sin/cos frequencies exp(-log10000*arange(0,width,2)/width), with no externally supplied timestamps/calendar/geography.
paper_code_differences: Paper Sec3.2 describes4-layer Transformer and2-layer fusion MLP; fixed tessera_infer v1 builder uses8layers, encoder width512 and SINGLE linear reducer to128. Port follows fixed v1 code.
Paper says GRU pooling; actual source computes GRU-conditioned attention weights and pools the ORIGINAL Transformer token values.
Paper includes mix-based regularization; pinned ssl_config.py has apply_mixup=False, and this independent MSE architecture identity omits ALL SSL/views/mix.
Source EO band counts10 and2 are replaced by genuine gyro3 andacc3, not synthetic imagery.
Replacing external day-of-year by internal relative sample position is a declared task adapter.
Diagnostic width/layer reductions have separate args and are only tests; default source512/8/4096 is not silently narrowed or capacity accepted.
adaptation.future_ssl_identity: A full train-only BT/sampling/globalshuffle/mix pretraining proposal remains a separate future identity and budget; it is NOT mixed into this architecture-only MSE table or claimed reproduced.
adaptation.capacity_risk: Large released v1 defaults unmeasured. No full-profile batch/stride/VRAM/time GO; common B128 cannot be silently reduced.
adaptation.dependency_scope: Standard torch Transformer/GRU only. No SSL BatchNorm/projector, raster/geospatial packages, external sensors or model weights.
